cross_check_template.note: One question per domain, re-testing the ORIGINAL Phase-1 top domain in a fresh concrete frame after narrowing. Selector picks the entry matching whichever domain was #1 after Phase 1.

MATH_LOGICAL.prompt: A friend is stuck on a tricky logic puzzle during lunch — do you get pulled in to help, or walk past it?

LIFE_SCIENCES_CARE.prompt: A classmate faints during PE — are you the one who instinctively rushes to check on them, or do you hang back and let others handle it?

HUMANITIES_SOCIAL.prompt: A heated debate breaks out in class about a current event — do you jump in with an opinion, or stay quiet and observe?

BUSINESS_COMMERCE.prompt: Your class is planning a fundraiser — do you volunteer to handle the budget/pricing, or a different task entirely?

CREATIVE_VISUAL.prompt: Your class needs a poster for an event by tomorrow — are you the one who offers to design it, or do you leave it to someone else?

PRACTICAL_APPLIED.prompt: A projector stops working right before class — do you get up to try fixing it, or wait for someone else to?

options.label: Get up to try fixing it

visible_verification_tiebreaker_template.note: Generic Phase-3 tiebreaker between current top-2 domains. Selector fills {A} and {B} with domain-appropriate concrete nouns (e.g. clubs, competitions) at runtime from a small phrase table below.
visible_verification_tiebreaker_template.prompt_template: One free elective period today — do you join the {A} club or the {B} club?

phase1_5_tiebreaker_template.note: Used when domains #2 and #3 from Phase 1 are within threshold of each other. Filled dynamically from domain_club_names or domain top-scoring Phase-1 option label.
phase1_5_tiebreaker_template.prompt_template: Which interests you more right now: {optionB} or {optionC}?

hidden_verification_commitment_questions.note: One reusable 'forced real-world commitment' question per domain, used in Phase 4. The selector pairs the top eligible domain against its current #2 domain and fills both sides.
hidden_verification_commitment_questions.prompt_template: If you had to pick one elective for the rest of the year — {A} or {B} — which would you actually pick?
hidden_verification_commitment_questions.secondary_commitment_prompt_template: A new club is starting — {A} Club or {B} Club — which do you sign up for?

confidence_gap.trigger: high domain score AND meta_flag for that domain absent/low from u5 AND no strong narrowing reinforcement yet
confidence_gap.prompt_template: You've shown a lot of interest in {domain_label}, but rated your confidence in it lower. Which feels more true: you enjoy it but don't feel confident yet, or you like the idea of it more than the actual coursework?

options.label: Enjoy it, just not confident yet
Like the idea more than the coursework

flat_profile.trigger: no domain meaningfully ahead after Phase 1
flat_profile.prompt_template: A few different areas seem to interest you fairly equally — which would you be most disappointed to not explore at all: technology, business, healthcare, arts, or social sciences?
flat_profile.note: Weighted lower than normal answers; also sets profile_status = broad_exploratory.
